opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search (one-way or return)
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for a flight from a departure airport to a destination airport on given dates with a given passenger count, then select the outbound and return flights.
steps: Open ryanair.com and select the 'Return trip' or 'One way' radio button.
Click the From field and pick the origin country and airport from the list.
Click the Destination field and pick the destination airport from the list.
Click the Depart field, navigate the calendar to the target month, and click the departure date.
If return trip, click the Return field and click the return date.
Open the Passengers dropdown, set Adults/Teens/Children/Infants with the +/- buttons, then click Done.
Click Search.
On the results page, click Select for the outbound flight, then Select for the return flight.

instances.values: Dublin to Athens, return trip, depart 2 Apr, return 5 Apr, 1 adult
Dublin to Malta, one way, depart 22 Apr, 2 adults
Tel Aviv to Venice Treviso, return trip, depart 9 May, return 16 May, 1 adult
Dublin to Paris Beauvais, return trip, depart 26 Apr, return 2 May, 2 adults (promo field also touched)

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and availability check
opportunities.description: Switch Resy to a city, search for a restaurant or cuisine by keyword, open the matching restaurant, and set the date and party size to check availability or set a Notify.
steps: If needed, click the city name at top-left and choose the target city from Popular Cities.
Click the 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.' box and type the keyword.
Click the matching restaurant in the dropdown.
On the restaurant page, open the Date picker and choose the target date.
Set the Guests dropdown to the party size.
Read the Lunch/Dinner slots, or click Notify on a slot (set a time window in the modal and click Confirm).
parameters: Restaurant to choose from the results

instances.values: Columbus OH, keyword 'thai', Senyai Thai Kitchen, Thu 6 Apr, 2 guests, Notify window 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Miami search, keyword 'high tide', High Tide (Dumbo), Fri 21 Apr changed to Mon 17 Apr, 2 guests, Notify on Lunch
Columbus OH switched to Sydney, keyword 'pasta', 2 guests, results list viewed

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for a destination or attraction, choose a date, open a result, and pick a ticket date/time and ticket counts.
steps: Open booking.com and click the Attractions tab (or go to the Attractions page).
Click the 'Where are you going?' field and type the destination or attraction, then pick the suggestion.
Click 'Select your dates' and choose the date, then click Search.
Click the target activity result, then 'See availability'.
Choose the date (or 'Show more dates' then the date on the calendar) and the time slot if shown.
Set the ticket counts (Adult, Child, Infant) with the +/- buttons and click Next.
parameters: Result to open (e.g., by sort order)

instances.values: Paris, 'Aquarium of Paris', date 5 May, time 10:00, 1 adult
Kyoto, date 25 May, Most popular sort, Tours filter, Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults and 1 infant; interrupted by Resy and other browsing around 2202-2266 s

opportunities.name: Event ticket search by performer or team and date filter
opportunities.description: Search a ticket marketplace for a performer or team, open the event listing, and filter the events by a date range or weekend.
steps: Open the ticket site and click the search box.
Type the artist, team, or event name and select the result.
Click 'Filter by Date' (or the date filter on the event list) and choose the start and end dates.
Click Apply, then review the listed events and their Buy/Tickets buttons.
parameters: Date range or preset (this weekend, next 7 days)

instances.values: SeatGeek, search 'Coldplay', date range April to May 2023, Apply
Ticket Center, Sports > MLB, Columbus OH events, 'This weekend' filter, Tickets on Chicago Cubs game
